meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作并渲染视频、动画与动态图形
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想快速制作宣传视频或动态图形,而不想从零写代码。
copy.tagline_en: Create and render videos, animations, and motion graphics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly produce promo videos or motion graphics without coding from scratch.

howto.what: 用户提出制作、编辑或渲染视频/动画/动效时,它先检查项目状态:有简报就按原流程继续,没有则做意图访谈,再按交付物类型选用并安装对应工作流,默认以 HyperFrames(HTML)形式产出视频。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作、编辑或渲染视频/动画/动效,或对已有 HyperFrames 项目做检查、预览等操作时触发;输入可以是网址、设计稿或音乐。

say.text: 把这家公司的官网做成一条产品宣传视频
say.note: 会进入产品宣传视频工作流

say.text: 给这段采访视频加上字幕,画面不要改
根据这首音乐生成一段卡点短视频
say.note: 音乐节奏会驱动画面切换

howto.what_en: When the user asks to make, edit, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, it first checks project state: resumes from an existing brief or runs an intent interview, then selects and installs the matching workflow, producing video from HTML via HyperFrames by default.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create, edit, or render a video/animation/motion graphic, or to inspect/preview an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may include a URL, design file, or music.

say_en.text: Make a product promo video from this company website.
Add captions to this interview footage without changing it.
Generate a beat-synced short video from this music track.
